set.body:
Objective
Switch all migrated predictive callers in the same slice and remove their old implementations, public builders and dead tests. Retain useful numerical kernels behind the new API.

Authority and inputs
PRD: docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md v0.2; requirements PRED-01, FND-05, OPS-01. Scientific/architecture/supplementary notes linked there preserve derivations and rationale. Planning baseline e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba plus untracked design documents is provenance, not a clean-tree or current-admission claim. Refresh only relevant sources/pins at claim time.

Owner role and starting seams
migration; modules/mvpa predictive legacy routes; mvpa-spatial/dataset adapters; docs and workflow examples. These are bounded ownership candidates, not a reservation of whole modules. Reserve exact touched paths when beginning; no assignee is fabricated by this plan.

Prerequisite packets
M1.11. Native Mote blocking edges are authoritative; stable keys/IDs are mapped in docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. Source-reference scans show no active migrated workflow calls the old engine or universal payload/Response/FoldPlan route.
2. Any shared old type still needed by a later inventoried workflow has a named M2/M3 owner and expiry, never new callers.
3. New examples are executable on both platforms where portable; breaking old-to-new guidance does not introduce shims.
4. Repeat affected JVM and JS parity tests after deletion, not merely before the cutover.

Verification
sbt mvpaJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaJS/test
sbt mvpaSpatialJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaSpatialJS/test
sbt mvpaDatasetJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaDatasetJS/test
These are candidate owning-module gates at the planning baseline: resolve any renamed module/test IDs at implementation start, and include affected consumer/parity scenarios. Use independent oracles and explicit tolerances; never report pending tests as passing.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet and required owner-local tests/docs. Reuse Gale/Multivar kernels, resample4s designs, Alder lifecycle and existing response/locus/estimates facilities; provider gaps stay explicit and require consumer admission. Do not add legacy enum cases or permanent compatibility wrappers, duplicate orchestration, a new registry/runtime, broad repo refactors, or silently change the scientific estimand to pass a resource/statistical gate. Migrate/delete per the M0 ledger. No Git push/release publication or foreign-store mutation is authorized by this ticket.
At handoff attach exact revisions, commands/results, scenario IDs, failure/caveat status, artifacts and next consumer. Semantic, numerical, scope, resource and scientific evidence remain separate. Independent audit tickets must use independently derived expectations/review, not repeat the implementation helper; unresolved criteria keep the task open.
set.title: UMVPA-M1.12: Cut over predictive APIs and delete replaced orchestration immediately
